summary: Villagers trying to claim claimed beds
description:
The bug

Breaking and placing a claimed bed in the same place causes a second villager to claim it, even though the original owner had not forgotten his bed location. This causes one villager to sleep at night while the other tries to claim the same bed.

What I expected to happen was...:

When replacing the claimed bed, the original owner would either discard his claim or the second villager would not try to claim it.

What actually happened was...:

Two villagers claimed the same bed.

To reproduce: 24w46a MC-197857.mp4

 - In Video Settings, set Particles to All

 - Make a trench two blocks deep

 - Place a bed and a villager

 - Wait for the villager to claim the bed (it will emit green particles)

 - Spawn another villager in the trench

 - Break and place the bed in the same position

 - Check if the second villager claims the bed (it will also emit green particles)

 - If it happens, use this command:

/time set night

 - You will see one villager sleeping in the bed, and the other constantly reclaiming the bed (with lots of green particles on his head
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft 24w46a and create a Creative world with default settings.
2. Open Options -> Video Settings and set Particles to All.
3. Make a trench two blocks deep.
4. Place a bed and a villager in the trench.
5. Wait until the villager claims the bed and emits green particles.
6. Observe the villager emitting green particles after claiming the bed.
7. Spawn another villager in the trench.
8. Break the bed and place it again in the same position.
9. Observe whether the second villager claims the bed and emits green particles; if it does, run `/time set night`.
10. Observe one villager sleeping in the bed while the other repeatedly tries to reclaim it, emitting lots of green particles.

Observed Behavior:
### What actually happened was...:

After the claimed bed was broken and a new bed was placed in the same position, the original villager retained its memory of the bed location while the second villager was also able to claim the newly placed bed. Both villagers therefore treated the same bed as their claimed bed.

The second villager emitted green claim particles despite the bed already being claimed. When the time was set to night, one villager slept in the bed while the other repeatedly attempted to claim the same bed, continuously producing green particles.
Expected Behavior: When a claimed bed is broken and replaced in the same position, the original villager should either discard its previous claim or retain exclusive ownership of the replacement bed. A second villager should not be able to claim the same bed, and at night only one villager should sleep in it without another repeatedly attempting to reclaim it.
